title: Physics
intro: Physics starts here with practice: a ladder of four levels that climbs from first problems to olympiad problems, then four topic sets from Newton's laws to quantum tunnelling. Every problem has a full worked solution, written so you can learn the method from it. Lessons for each topic will follow, and the problems will stay as their practice.

1.title: The ladder
1.blurb: Four levels of problems, from basics through intermediate and advanced to olympiad. Climb in order.
1.label: Ladder

2.title: Topic sets
2.blurb: Mechanics, waves and electromagnetism, heat and statistical physics, relativity and quantum physics.
2.label: Topics
